nearby.intro_desc:
When you and a friend both enable this and are within your chosen radius, you'll get a suggestion to create a meetup.

⚠️ We never share your friend's exact location. You only receive a notification saying "You and a friend are nearby."
nearby.opt_in_sub: Both sides must enable this for it to work
nearby.disable_body: You won't receive meetup suggestions when friends are nearby.
nearby.cooldown_desc:
To avoid spam, suggestions are limited to once per 2 hours per friend pair.
Remaining: {{time}}
nearby.detected_title: 🎉 You and a friend are nearby!
nearby.privacy_note: 🔒 Privacy: We never reveal the exact location or address of your friends, and vice versa.
nearby.detected_subtitle: Friends are currently within your chosen radius
